name: Ward's Manufacturing
old_description: Founded by siblings Kiffin and Kelly Ward, the company is committed to domestic manufacturing and building long-term partnerships by delivering high-quality, made-in-USA parts with unmatched flexibility.
about:
Ward's Manufacturing operates from Warren, Rhode Island, where siblings Kiffin and Kelly Ward founded the company in 2022. The brother‑sister team, both former buyers of fabrication services, launched the shop after experiencing the difficulties of sourcing reliable domestic metalwork. Their family background includes a grandfather who was a carpenter rebuilding post‑war London and another who worked as an auto mechanic and metalworker, instilling a service‑oriented trade ethic. The business is certified as a woman‑owned small business.

The shop provides fiber laser cutting (3 kW, 5 × 10 ft bed, ±0.001″ cut tolerance), CNC press brake bending (190‑ton, up to 10 ft length), machining (thread cutting, countersinking, counterboring, reaming, inserts, laser etching), and in‑house finishing (#4 brushed, vibratory tumbling, glass bead blasting, orbital sanding). Product design and engineering support covers CAD creation from sketches, design optimization, and GD&T expertise. Value‑added services include powder coating, wet painting, anodizing, assembly, welding, and a range of surface treatments. There is no minimum order quantity; the company runs from single prototypes to production runs of tens of thousands of units and has shipped to 43 U.S. states and four Canadian provinces.

Customers span aerospace and defense, marine and boat building, robotics and automation, electronics and enclosure fabrication, renewable energy (wind turbine and solar components), medical devices, industrial equipment, automotive, and niche sectors such as shellfish aquaculture, art, and custom signage. The client base consists mainly of small‑to‑mid‑sized OEMs and manufacturers across North America who require tight tolerances and fast turnaround.

Ward's differentiates itself with a 99 % quality rate, domestic production in Warren, and a collaborative approach that includes expedited 24‑ to 48‑hour rush delivery, no minimum orders, and woman‑owned/green‑manufacturer certifications that help clients meet supplier‑diversity and sustainability goals.
